stem_book: A river flows due south with a speed of 2.0 ms⁻¹. A man steers a motorboat across the river; his velocity relative to the water is 4 ms⁻¹ due east. The river is 800 m wide. What is the magnitude of his velocity (in ms⁻¹) relative to the earth?
correct_answer: 4.472 ms⁻¹ (= 2√5, directed tan⁻¹(1/2) ≈ 26.6° south of east)
reason: Print asks for 'magnitude and direction'; key gives only the magnitude, so stem narrowed to the magnitude (direction kept in correct_answer).
